description: Keeps the pins Dependabot cannot see moving: Mill itself, the Mill plugins and the Scala
dependencies in build.mill, and the version-plus-sha256 pairs for the tools CI downloads.
GitHub Actions pins stay with .github/dependabot.yml, so that manager is disabled here.
Renovate has no Mill manager (checked against docs.renovatebot.com/modules/manager/ and the
lib/modules/manager tree on 2026-09-29), so every Mill-side pin is read by a regex manager:
the `//| - group::artifact:version` plugin header of build.mill, the `val name = "x.y.z"`
lines of `object Versions` — each annotated with the Maven coordinate it stands for, because
the artifact is named at the use site and not beside the version — and .mill-version.
Tool downloads are pinned by version AND checksum. The regex managers capture both halves
so a proposal changes them together; Renovate's github-releases datasource looks the new
asset's digest up from the release. A version bump that arrives without a matching checksum
fails loudly anyway — sha256sum --check in the toolchain action, and scripts/cpd.sh refusing
a PMD_VERSION it has no PMD_SHA256 for — so nothing here can quietly widen a pin.

packageRules.description: Mill, its plugins and the compiler move on their own: each is a build change, not a library bump.
mill-contrib-scoverage is versioned with Mill itself and must match .mill-version — one pull request for both.
Tool pins: version and checksum in one change, under the ci scope the workflow files use.

customManagers.description: Mill itself. .mill-version holds one version string; the bootstrap script fetches com.lihaoyi:mill-dist from Maven Central.
Mill plugins declared with a double `::` in build.mill's header — cross-built per Mill line, published as <artifact>_mill1_3.
Mill plugins declared with a single `::` in build.mill's header — cross-built for Scala 3 only, published as <artifact>_3.

The `object Versions` pins in build.mill. Each `val` carries a trailing `// renovate: depName=<group>:<artifact>` naming one artifact that is published under that version, because the mvn"…" strings name the artifact at the use site, not beside the version.
scala-cli in the toolchain action and the Forgejo workflow: version and sha256 of the x86_64 Linux asset, captured as one pin.
The Coursier CLI in the toolchain action: version and sha256 of the x86_64 Linux asset, captured as one pin.
PMD in scripts/cpd.sh: the default version and the sha256 of its pmd-dist-<version>-bin.zip, captured as one pin. PMD tags releases pmd_releases/<version>.
